asks.message: CARDDEMO profile: compiler is not in the store — which compiler builds the module
asks.request: Provide the compile JCL (Enterprise COBOL release and the PROC used) for the module

asks.message: CARDDEMO profile: compiler_options is not in the store — which compiler options the module is built with
asks.request: Provide the compile step PARM= (NUMPROC, TRUNC, DYNAM, ARCH, ...) the module is built with; options change behaviour, so they belong to the build path

asks.message: CARDDEMO profile: copybook_library_concatenation is not in the store — out of which libraries the module compiles its copybooks
asks.request: Provide the SYSLIB concatenation of the module's compile JCL (copybook library order)

asks.message: CARDDEMO profile: database_managers is not in the store — which database systems the estate runs, and at which level — assumed 'IBM Db2 for z/OS 12' from mftb's typical-shop defaults until somebody confirms it
asks.request: List the database systems installed (Db2, IMS DL/I, IDMS, Adabas, ...) with their versions: the scan proves only what this module touches, which is a lower bound

asks.message: CARDDEMO profile: db2_library_level is not in the store — which DB2 level the module is built and run against
asks.request: Provide the DB2 library concatenation (SDSNLOAD / SDSNEXIT) of the module's steps, which names the DB2 level

asks.message: CARDDEMO profile: db2_plans is not in the store — which plans the module runs under
asks.request: Provide the plan / package names the module runs under (DSN RUN cards or the bind JCL)

asks.message: CARDDEMO profile: db2_subsystem is not in the store — which DB2 subsystem the module binds and runs against
asks.request: State the DB2 subsystem id the module runs against in production

asks.message: CARDDEMO profile: environment_topology is not in the store — which LPARs and environments (production / test / DR) the estate has — the scanned JCL allocates datasets under the high-level qualifier(s) AWS, OEM: a naming observation, which is not proof of which LPAR or environment runs them
asks.request: State the LPARs and environments, how a dataset or job name says which one it belongs to, and which sysplex they sit in: the scan can only list the qualifiers it saw

asks.message: CARDDEMO profile: library_manager is not in the store — which source / change manager holds the members — assumed 'Broadcom Endevor' from mftb's typical-shop defaults until somebody confirms it
asks.request: State the source library manager (Endevor, ChangeMan, Panvalet, Librarian, plain PDS) and how a member is promoted to production

asks.message: CARDDEMO profile: masking_policy is not in the store — what may leave the estate, and in what shape
asks.request: State the data-masking policy for extracted test data (which fields must be masked, whether production data may leave the estate at all)

asks.message: CARDDEMO is built and run under 2 build paths: BP01 = AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB; BP02 = AWS.M2.LBD.TXT2PDF.LOAD — the module is not one unit of migration, each path is
asks.request: Confirm that the 2 build paths are intended (different DB2 level, load concatenation or compile options inside one module) and which one the migration targets

asks.message: CARDDEMO profile: online_monitors reads IBM CICS Transaction Server from this module's store, which is what this module proves and not what the estate has — which transaction monitors the estate runs, and at which level
asks.request: List the online monitors installed (CICS TS, IMS TM, none) with their versions: the scan proves only what this module uses, which is a lower bound

asks.message: CARDDEMO profile: output_manager is not in the store — which product owns the printed output once it leaves the spool — 118 DD(s) write to SYSOUT: the jobs print, but a spool class never names the product that archives or delivers the output — assumed 'Broadcom CA View' from mftb's typical-shop defaults until somebody confirms it
asks.request: State the output / report manager (CA View, CA Deliver, Control-D, CA Spool) and what it does with each SYSOUT class the jobs write to

asks.message: CARDDEMO profile: security_manager is not in the store — which external security manager guards the datasets — assumed 'IBM RACF' from mftb's typical-shop defaults until somebody confirms it
asks.request: State the security manager (RACF, CA ACF2, CA Top Secret) and who owns the dataset profiles

asks.message: CARDDEMO profile: sort_product is not in the store — which sort product PGM=SORT resolves to — 4 step(s) run PGM=SORT, the site linkage alias: a sort runs, the product is unnamed — assumed 'IBM DFSORT' from mftb's typical-shop defaults until somebody confirms it
asks.request: State the sort product installed (IBM DFSORT or Syncsort MFX): PGM=SORT is a linkage alias and does not say which one runs

asks.message: CARDDEMO profile: standard_compiler is not in the store — which compiler the shop builds production code with — assumed 'IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS 6.3' from mftb's typical-shop defaults until somebody confirms it
asks.request: State the shop-standard compiler and release (Enterprise COBOL 6.x, ...); a single module's compile step is that module's, not the estate's

asks.message: CARDDEMO profile: standard_compiler_options is not in the store — which compile options the shop builds production code with — assumed 'RENT,NUMPROC(NOPFD),TRUNC(STD),ARCH(8),SSRANGE(NO)' from mftb's typical-shop defaults until somebody confirms it
asks.request: State the shop-standard compile options (NUMPROC, TRUNC, ARCH, RENT, SSRANGE, ...) a module is expected to be built with

asks.message: CARDDEMO profile: tape_manager is not in the store — which tape manager owns the volumes the jobs allocate — assumed 'Broadcom CA 1' from mftb's typical-shop defaults until somebody confirms it
asks.request: State the tape / removable-media manager (CA 1, CA TLMS, DFSMSrmm) and the retention rules it applies: UNIT=TAPE proves tape is used, never which catalogue owns it

asks.message: CARDDEMO profile: test_lpar is not in the store — whether a test LPAR is available to run the migrated code against
asks.request: Confirm whether a test LPAR (or a sandbox subsystem) is available for parallel runs, and who can grant access

asks.message: CARDDEMO profile: volumes is not in the store — how much data the module moves per run
asks.request: Provide the production volumes (records in / out per run, DB2 row counts, file sizes) the module handles

asks.message: CARDDEMO profile: zos_version is not in the store — which z/OS release the estate runs — assumed 'IBM z/OS 2.5' from mftb's typical-shop defaults until somebody confirms it
asks.request: State the z/OS release of the production LPAR (D IPLINFO, or the release the shop is on)
